name: the_circular_pattern_turns_around_a_straight_edge
why: Z-C21.9, finding M16, measured NOT REAL by the Z-C21.3 probe of L7-5 and M16 (28/9/2026, SOLIDWORKS 29.5.1): circular_pattern takes a straight EDGE as its axis and selects it with IEntity.SelectByMark and mark 1, while the marks table of IFeatureManager~FeatureCircularPattern5.html names only a feature or an axis selected with IFeature::Select2 or SelectByID2. The probe's case C1 (the bridge's call) made the four copies around the edge exactly, as the axis made from two planes did (C0); IEntity.Select4 with mark 1 did too (C3), and only SelectByID2 of the edge by a point failed to select it (C2). No bench case turned a pattern around an edge until this one.
_what_it_catches: An edge that SOLIDWORKS does not take as the axis: no pattern, or copies around another axis, which puts the holes elsewhere (the centres) or into the square hole or out of the plate (the volume).
_the_numbers: Plate 200 x 120 x 20 on the front plane, centred, 480000 mm3. The seed is a through hole D6 at (20, 0): pi x 3^2 x 20 = 565.487 mm3. A square through hole 10 x 10 centred at (5, 5) has a corner edge along Z at x = 0, y = 0, 20 long: 2000 mm3. Four instances over 360 degrees around that edge put the copies 20 from it, at (0, 20), (-20, 0) and (0, -20), whatever the sense of the edge; none reaches the square (its farthest corner is 14.1 from the edge, the nearest hole wall 17). 480000 - 2000 - 4 x 565.487 = 475738.053 mm3, as the probe's C1 (the same plate on the top plane: 197434.513 -> 195738.053, three copies of 565.487).

expect.tolerance_why: the axis of the cylinder is read from CylinderParams, in metres
480000 minus pi x 3^2 x 20: the sum has pi in it
minus 10 x 10 x 20 = 2000 exactly; the half cubic millimetre is the hole's pi
the diameters are read from CylinderParams, in metres

expect.why: THE AXIS IS THE EDGE: the seed at (20, 0) and its copies at (0, 20), (-20, 0), (0, -20). Around any other axis these numbers change

expect.tolerance_why: minus three more holes of 565.487: the sum has pi in it
expect.why: three whole copies, none in the square hole or out of the plate
